sources.title: Clinical evaluation of software (MDR Art. 61 / MDCG 2020-1)
sources.why: Defines scientific validity, analytical and clinical performance — the core proof that content is clinically validated rather than merely estimated.

sources.title: IVDR — in-vitro diagnostic software (Regulation (EU) 2017/746)
sources.why: Requires a performance evaluation (validity + analytical + clinical) before outputs derived from specimen data may be claimed as reliable.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 82304-2 — health software quality & safety
sources.why: Governs how non-device health-information and wellness apps substantiate quality and safety claims about the content they present.
